The loop gain of about 25 with GBW of about 1.3 GHz at the lightly loaded internal node gives a near-Butterworth bandwidth of about 30 MHz. The follower isolates the 200 fF load, with its pole at more than 4x f3db. Because Rf feeds back from vout, vout_dc equals Vgs1, about 0.5 V. Budget: Iref 5 + 1.5 + 9 + 7 uA, about 41 uW."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":   (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input CS device gm/Id
    "L1":      (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),       # input device L
    "I1":      (9e-6, 5e-6, 13e-6),    # gain-stage current
    "gmid_p":  (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load / its diode gm/Id
    "Lp":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # PMOS load L
    "Isf":     (7e-6, 4e-6, 10e-6),    # source-follower current
    "gmid_sf": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # follower gm/Id
    "Rf":      (470e3, 400e3, 700e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":      (1e-15, 1e-16, 2e-14),  # feedback cap (stability/peaking trim)
    "Ipb":     (1.5e-6, 0.8e-6, 3e-6), # PMOS bias-branch current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    I1, Isf, Ipb = p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Ipb"]
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    vdd = 1.8

    # Gain device; its Vgs sets vin = vout DC (no DC current in Rf)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)
    vin = m1.vgs

    # NMOS source follower (inside the loop), bulk = vss so vsb = vout
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], 0.15, Isf, vds=vdd - vin, vsb=vin)
    vx = vin + msf.vgs

    # PMOS current-source load and its diode reference
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(vdd - vx, 0.2))
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=m2.vgs)

    # NMOS mirror bank from ibias (same gm/Id and L)
    gmb, Lb = 12.0, 1.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mn1 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, Ipb, vds=vdd - mp0.vgs)
    msk = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, Isf, vds=vin)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.dev("MSK", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msk)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- analytic prediction ----
    g_x = m1.gds + m2.gds
    A0 = m1.gm / g_x
    asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + msk.gds)
    Ab0 = A0 * asf
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + msf.cgd + (1 - asf) * max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    wa = g_x / Cx
    wsf = (msf.gm + msf.gmbs) / (cl + msk.cdd + 0.2 * msf.cgg)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cfe = Cf + m1.cgd  # Miller cap of M1 acts as extra feedback cap

    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 4000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Ab = Ab0 / ((1 + s / wa) * (1 + s / wsf))
    Zf = Rf / (1 + s * Rf * Cfe)
    Z = Ab * Zf / (1 + Ab + s * Cin * Zf)
    Zm = np.abs(Z)
    Z0 = Zm[0]
    idx = np.where(Zm < Z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else float(f[-1])

    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    vn2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 * (m1.gm + m2.gm) / m1.gm ** 2
    yin = abs(1 / (Rf / (1 + 1j * w1 * Rf * Cfe)) + 1j * w1 * Cin)
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + vn2 * yin ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + Ipb + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(Z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vin,
    }
```
